newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares gain in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares gain in quiet trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares gained in slow trade on Wednesday with dairy company Birzhu the most active stock, the stock exchange said.
Central market volume was 422,873 litas, lower than on Tuesday, and the group A index, which tracks the central market's 36 most traded stocks, rose by 57.95 points.
Birzhu dairy rose to 6.54 litas from 5.45 on turnover of 140,557 litas and Lithuanian Gas also went up to 1.11 litas from one lit turning over 70,962 litas.
Ragutis brewery continued to be traded actively with turnover of 94,620 litas and rose 0.1 percent to 9.09 litas.
Block trading came to 213,129 litas and Lithuanian Gas was also traded here, registering business of 130,556 litas at a price range of 1.11 to 0.80 litas.
Government securities turned over a tiny 390 litas.
